title: wkappbot ask gpt zombie process -- 4-5 GB memory leak detection and fix
desc: ask gpt --timeout Ns can hang as a zombie consuming 4-5 GB RAM. Detection and immediate kill procedure.
steps: SYMPTOM: system memory 80pct+. Get-Process sorted by WorkingSet64 shows wkappbot-core or wkappbot-core.new at 4000-5000 MB.
IDENTIFY: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter Name LIKE wkappbot-core%
Select ProcessId,WorkingSetSize,CommandLine. Look for CommandLine containing 'ask' 'gpt' '--timeout'. These are zombie pipeline health checks that hung.
ROOT CAUSE: ask gpt fires with short --timeout (e.g. 3s) but the CDP/GPT pipeline hangs. Process keeps retrying internally and leaks memory over hours.
KILL: C:/Windows/System32/taskkill.exe /F /PID <pid1> /PID <pid2>. User must authorize (per CLAUDE.md kill-protection rule).
FREED: each zombie releases 4-5 GB. Two zombies = ~10 GB. System returns to normal immediately.
PREVENTION: suggest to WKAppBot team -- add OOM watchdog that kills ask-gpt subprocesses if WorkingSet64 > 2 GB. File suggest with repro steps.
SEEN: 2026-05-24, PIDs 23840 (4925 MB) and 32976 (4787 MB), both running ask gpt pipeline health check.

requirements.cmd: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter " Name LIKE wkappbot-core% " | Where WorkingSetSize -gt 1000000000

requirements.expect: ERROR: The process 99999 not found (safe: nonexistent PID)
top process is no longer wkappbot-core after fix --exit-event wkappbot-exit-37856
